viewing_check: Check the weave and dyes: hand-spun uneven cotton and dull natural reds/browns suggest old; bright even red and fine commercial-looking yarn suggest 20th century. Measure the panel, look at the back for backing, tears and old repairs, and whether it is a cut fragment or a complete (usually about 2m) pua. Photograph the reverse and a close-up of the weave.
